# Tech Recycling Berlin

> Certified IT disposal, GDPR-compliant data erasure, and sustainable IT recycling for companies, authorities, and institutions in Berlin and across Germany. Pickup, destruction, remarketing and recycling — all from a single, accredited provider, with legally valid certificates and full chain-of-custody.

Tech Recycling Berlin (Keithstraße 15, 10787 Berlin, Germany) is an accredited waste-disposal specialist (Entsorgungsfachbetrieb per EfbV / ElektroG) offering end-to-end IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) services. All data erasure follows BSI and DIN 66399 standards; every job is documented with an audit-ready certificate. The company serves roughly 500 business clients and recycles over 50 tonnes of hardware annually with a > 98 % material-recovery rate.

## Core services (Deutsch)
- [Sichere Datenlöschung](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/sichere-datenloeschung.html): DSGVO-konforme Datenvernichtung nach BSI- und DIN 66399-Standards mit Löschzertifikat.
- [IT-Ankauf & Remarketing](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/it-ankauf.html): Marktgerechter Ankauf werthaltiger Hardware nach zertifizierter Datenlöschung.
- [IT Recycling](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/it-recycling.html): Fachgerechtes Recycling nach ElektroG; >98 % Rohstoffrückführung.
- [Festplattenvernichtung](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/festplattenvernichtung.html): Physische HDD-/SSD-Zerstörung vor Ort oder im Hochsicherheitsverfahren.
- [Server-Entsorgung](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/server-entsorgung.html): Abbau, Transport und Entsorgung ganzer Serverräume und Rechenzentren.
- [Datenrettung](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/datenrettung.html): Wiederherstellung verlorener Daten im zertifizierten Reinraumlabor.

## Core services (English)
- [Secure Data Erasure](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/en/secure-data-erasure.html): GDPR-compliant data destruction per BSI and DIN 66399 with a legally valid erasure certificate.
- [IT Buyback & Remarketing](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/en/it-buyback.html): Market-fair buyback of high-value hardware after certified erasure.
- [IT Recycling](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/en/it-recycling.html): Professional e-waste recycling per ElektroG / WEEE; > 98 % material recovery.
- [Hard Drive Destruction](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/en/hard-drive-destruction.html): Physical HDD/SSD destruction on-site or in our high-security facility.
- [Server Disposal](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/en/server-disposal.html): Dismantling, transport and disposal of server rooms and data centres.
- [Data Recovery](https://techrecycling-berlin.com/en/data-recovery.html): Recovery of lost data in our certified cleanroom lab.

## Certifications & standards
- Certified waste-disposal operator (Entsorgungsfachbetrieb per EfbV)
- Compliant with German ElektroG / EU WEEE Directive 2012/19/EU
- Data erasure per BSI (Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik) and DIN 66399
- GDPR / EU-DSGVO compliant processes
- Chain-of-custody documentation for every pickup

## Typical customers
Mid-size and enterprise companies, data centres, public authorities, banks, law firms, hospitals, universities, and start-ups in Berlin and Brandenburg, plus nationwide pickups across Germany.

## Quote & response times
Non-binding quote within 24 hours by phone, email, or the website form. Same-day response for urgent decommissioning projects. Free pickup within Berlin and the greater Berlin-Brandenburg area.
